input_scope: Eight deterministic single-locale projections of existing actual model generation. Four exposed goal interpretations; no new model or retrieval calls by this review. Product scores and product-review.json not read.

dimensions.rationale: Python tasks, retries, schedules and all four prohibited dependencies are preserved.
Background-job queue and scheduler fit the route and goal.
Huey SQLite has a conditional preferred role; API, handlers, idempotency, operations and business consistency remain team-owned.
Existing-path/custom comparisons use the same task scope and preference reversal depends on recovery and SQLite limits.
Repository URL, dated catalog snapshot and supplied host observation are distinguished; no fresh network or implementation claim.
Version, license, environment, throughput, locking, total adoption effort and non-atomic cross-store writes remain unresolved; hours are hypothetical.
Isolated synthetic task, cron, deliberate error, restart and outbox crash windows are concrete; rollback preserves both stores and reconciles pending/in-flight work.
The recommendation and reuse/custom tradeoff are explained; non-atomic writes and retry reconciliation are connected to business effects.
The separately authorized bounded pilot names inputs, tests, acceptance, data preservation and recovery; real API switching is excluded from the proposal.
Prohibited dependencies, synthetic inputs, authoritative business data preservation and action authority remain explicit.

dimensions.rationale: Go HTTP/REST requirement is retained; a secondary Go label does not qualify ABP.
Gin routing/middleware fits the HTTP framework role.
Gin precedes Go handlers; domain logic, storage, authorization and operations remain team-owned; net/http is a same-endpoint alternative.
ABP is excluded by actual .NET foundation; a sufficient standard-library option or incompatible middleware/version/dependency can reverse preference.
Gin and ABP primary URLs, snapshot date and supplied fresh README observation are distinguished without production readiness.
Go HTTP experience is an explicit scenario prerequisite in both locales; version/license, environment and total effort remain unknown.
Isolated synthetic REST endpoint tests success/error JSON/status, middleware and cancellation; rollback disables endpoint and only restores a known handler.
Conditional decision, dependency cost, same-scope comparison and unproven savings are understandable.
Separately authorized endpoint implementation, contract checks and net/http comparison form a concrete bounded handoff with acceptance and rollback.
No authoritative-data change, main-service switch, tools or network execution is claimed; implementation needs separate authorization.

retained_gaps: Proxy review does not establish human acceptance, browser no-call switching, source operability or publication recovery.
Model generations use previously interpreted/source-authored cases; no fresh interpretation or globally unseen task claim.
Independent newly frozen retrieval capture failed baseline nDCG nonregression and invoice recall strata; answer proxy success cannot override retrieval failure.
Hours are validation-only hypothetical scenarios; no measured engineering speedup, total adoption estimate or delivery commitment.
adjudication: Parent compares original independent receipts without rewriting first passes; dimension difference >1 or critical disagreement requires recorded adjudication.
